scope: Independent source reading by collaborating agents in this task; not an external audit or runtime test result

reviews.basis: IssuerPurpose is an existing public re-export; the explicit import fixes its test scope. From<[u8; 64]> constructs the Ed25519 variant without truncation; the original signature and IssuerMissing assertion remain unchanged.
The private five-element tuple alias is exactly the original SQL row type. Query, column order, serialization, transaction and owner/verification behavior are unchanged. No lint suppression.

The same key pins, directory permissions, frontier, owner and signing errors propagate into nine Result test functions. All original tests and assertions remain; no default value or skip is introduced.
All three original test names and request boundaries remain. Bind errors still fail the Result test; service errors and thread panics still fail through Drop.

Nine calls propagate process helper failure into three Result test entries. The original 25 assertions, commands, 10-second deadline, 5-ms poll and OwnedChild kill/wait remain. This preserves the original behavior; it does not establish an operating-system preemption guarantee.
